description: Nonprofits, foundations, advocacy, think tanks, civic tech and NGOs: public Greenhouse / Lever / SmartRecruiters boards, a few Workday and ADP job sites found by discover_boards.py, and the Chronicle of Philanthropy keyword feed. Program, development, communications, policy, operations and direct-service roles. Idealist, Work for Good and Bridgespan render in the browser only and are watch entries.
source: built 2026-10-11 for jobkit v0.3; every active entry live-fetched that day. Found by discover_boards.py the same day: American Red Cross (Workday), Teach For America (Workday), Habitat for Humanity International (Workday), United Way Worldwide (ADP), Doctors Without Borders USA (Greenhouse), Planned Parenthood (one Lever board per affiliate; only the federation board ships here - add your region's with discover_boards). Not reachable / no API that day (watch entries): Idealist (no RSS, browser app), Work for Good (board replaced by a weekly post), Bridgespan (browser app), Foundation List (no feed items), International Rescue Committee (timeouts), Mercy Corps, Save the Children, Feeding America, World Wildlife Fund (iCIMS, client-rendered).
